hero.tagline: I build product-minded interfaces that help people finish what they came to do.

about.title: About
about.lede: I'm a frontend engineer with four years of experience, currently at eDreams, working on the tools travellers reach for when something has gone wrong with a booking.
about.p2: The work I'm most pleased with there is intent recognition in the support search bar: reading what someone actually means and sending them straight to the right support option, instead of handing them a list of guesses to sift through. Fewer dead ends, fewer people giving up. That's the kind of problem I like — narrow in scope, obvious in value the moment you use it.
about.p3: I studied Computer Science, work mostly in React and TypeScript, and I'm comfortable picking up whatever a project actually needs. This site is a case in point: I built and operate the whole thing, front to back. I recently moved to Warsaw and I'm open to frontend roles here, hybrid or on-site.

work.title: Work
work.closing: React first, adaptable to the rest.

aboutMe.outcome: A self-hosted fullstack portfolio I design, ship, and operate — SPA, API, Docker on a Pi, tunnel, and CI. Built to prove the stack, not pad a resume.

architecture.hint: Click a box to inspect it. Pinch or use the controls to zoom. Scrolling still moves the page.

gha.title: GitHub Actions
gha.body: Every push to main runs checks, builds ARM64 images, and publishes them to GHCR so the Pi can pull a known artifact.

ghcr.title: GHCR
ghcr.body: The registry that holds the web and API images. Deploy is a pull on the Pi, not a copy over SSH.

pi.title: Raspberry Pi
pi.body: An ARM64 Ubuntu box at home running Docker Compose. It only makes outbound connections — nothing is exposed on the router.

browser.title: Browser
browser.body: A visitor loads joelitoo.com over HTTPS. Cloudflare terminates TLS and forwards the request through the tunnel.

tunnel.title: Cloudflare Tunnel
tunnel.body: The Pi opens an outbound tunnel; nothing is port-forwarded on the home router; Cloudflare maps hostnames to containers.

web.title: web (nginx)
web.body: A static Vite build served by nginx. Cloudflare routes joelitoo.com to this container.

api.title: api (NestJS)
api.body: Health checks and the contact form. Cloudflare routes api.joelitoo.com to this container.

umami.title: Umami
umami.body: Self-hosted analytics at analytics.joelitoo.com. Page views and custom events, no third-party tracker.

pgApp.title: Postgres (app)
pgApp.body: The NestJS API's database, reached through Prisma. Same Postgres server, a separate database.

pgUmami.title: Postgres (Umami)
pgUmami.body: Umami's own database on the same Postgres instance, isolated from the app data.
